mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 82 degrees with clear skies near Verona Area High School. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 67 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has posted notices for the upcoming partisan primary and the November 3 general election. Additionally, drivers should be aware that road construction on Highway M starts August 18, requiring traffic shifts and utility work for the next few weeks.

There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Trivia Night at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, plus live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch the free Concerts in the Park series at Century School Park.
On August 8, Verona police assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office with a vehicle rollover crash where the driver fled the scene, but was successfully located and arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Butter Pecan. The store is currently closed but will reopen at 10 AM tomorrow, when you can try the Really Reese's flavor.
